# Upstream TOML fixtures

These cases appear in the official
[toml-test v2.2.0 TOML 1.0 case list](https://github.com/toml-lang/toml-test/blob/v2.2.0/tests/files-toml-1.0.0).
Fixture contents were retrieved from the upstream main branch because the
tagged fixture URLs were unavailable in the development environment. Paths
are relative to the upstream `tests/` directory.

- [valid/integer/underscore](https://github.com/toml-lang/toml-test/blob/main/tests/valid/integer/underscore.toml)
- [valid/float/exponent](https://github.com/toml-lang/toml-test/blob/main/tests/valid/float/exponent.toml)
- [invalid/bool/capitalized-true](https://github.com/toml-lang/toml-test/blob/main/tests/invalid/bool/capitalized-true.toml)

The fixture license is included in this directory.
